rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a controlled scientific or practical test.

example.english: This experiment has to be conducted under controlled conditions.
example.traditional: 呢個實驗要喺控制條件下進行。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 jiu3 hai2 hung3 zai3 tiu4 gin6 haa6 zeon3 hang4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression for conducting an experiment.

example.english: We are conducting an experiment in the lab today.
example.traditional: 我哋今日喺實驗室做實驗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 hai2 sat6 jim6 sat1 zou6 sat6 jim6

rows.note: Use this for casually trying something out to see what happens, rather than carrying out a formal study.

example.english: This method is interesting, so I'll experiment with it first.
example.traditional: 呢個方法幾得意，我試吓先。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 gei2 dak1 ji3 ngo5 si3 haa5 sin1
